source_survey_or_base_map: Saxon/Thuringian regional material; dedicated to Friedrich Christian, Electoral Prince of Saxony
independence_reason: Different house, country, engraver and dedicatee from the Vaugondy sheet, and a five times finer scale, so it is not the same plate or a reissue of it. Both sheets nevertheless use the Ferro meridian and both belong to the eighteenth-century compilation tradition, so partial rather than full independence is claimed.
